headline: O'Reilly Called Off For test3331
deck: O'Reilly, owned by test3331, withdraws injured from the England squad for the final two Nations League fixtures.
body:
O'Reilly has pulled out of the England squad for England's last two Nations League games of the break, injured. For test3331 it is the second fitness flag on the asset in a week, the doubt against the Czech Republic now hardened into a withdrawal.

No timeline came with it, and none is invented here. What is known is that he does not feature for the rest of the international window, and test3331 waits on what comes back.
